about_the_game:
Lizards Must Die 2: Soundtrack is the most powerful audio accompaniment for Russ vs Lizards 2 game. The edition includes all tracks from the game.

The fierce background combined with folk and folk motifs perfectly emphasizes the originality of the project, but it is good in itself. Rhythmic tracks from top performers are an excellent choice for the methodical disintegration of the damned lizards. 25 fast and bouncy tracks from Lastfragment, SKWLKR, kagayaku and Umcorn are waiting for you in the first part of the album.

In the second part of the album, you can find 18 beautiful ambient songs that you could hear in the game in those seconds when you weren't being attacked from all sides by hundreds of reptiles. The melodies composed by Umcorn perfectly convey the atmosphere of Ancient Russia and immerse you in the world of Hyperborea.

Well, for sweets - the main theme from the main menu, composed by the Yagoda group.

Goida, Rus brothers! This is truly a great addition to the game.
